issues.description: Default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta is 'shubh' in code but documented as 'aditya' in docstrings and PR description
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh' for bulbul:v3-beta, while the module docstring, class docstring, and PR text all promise 'aditya'. This is a direct contract violation: callers relying on the documented default get a different voice. Pick one and make spec and code agree.

issues.description: Pace silently clamped to model subrange, contradicting the InputParams Field(ge=0.3, le=3.0) contract
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace bounds at the pydantic layer; __init__ then silently narrows and clamps for v3-beta with only a warning. The precondition is stated in two layers that disagree. Either raise ValueError (matching the unsupported-model path) or narrow the Field bounds — pick one enforcement discipline.

issues.description: Unsupported-parameter warnings compare against defaults, producing both false positives and false negatives
issues.detail: Checks like params.pitch != 0.0, params.loudness != 1.0, params.temperature != 0.6 conflate 'user explicitly set the default' with 'user omitted the parameter'. A user passing the default gets no warning; a v2 user setting temperature=0.5 is warned while one setting 0.6 is not. Use a None sentinel or model_fields_set to detect explicit input.

issues.description: STT connect_kwargs silently drops input_audio_codec, a behavior change presented as a refactor
issues.detail: The pre-PR connect payload included 'input_audio_codec': self._input_audio_codec; the refactored payload removes it with no comment. If the SDK still relies on it, this is a silent regression for existing saarika:v2.5 and saaras:v2.5 deployments. State the reason or restore the field.

issues.description: voice_id is never validated against the selected model's speakers tuple despite the data being available
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS carries a per-model speakers tuple and v2/v3 speaker enums exist, but __init__ never checks voice_id against them. A v2 speaker passed with v3-beta is accepted and fails server-side instead of raising a clear client-side ValueError at construction. Use the data you built.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently returns v2 speakers for any unknown model name
issues.detail: The helper accepts an unconstrained str and falls back to v2 speakers on miss with no diagnostic. Callers cannot distinguish 'unknown model' from 'v2 model'. Raise ValueError (consistent with __init__) or return an empty list — do not invent a default.

synthesis.summary: The refactor to ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig dataclass tables is the right architectural direction, replacing fragile substring sniffing with data-driven dispatch. The panel agrees on five P1 contract problems: the v3-beta default speaker disagrees between code (shubh) and docs (aditya); pace is silently clamped despite a wider Field contract; 'ignored parameter' warnings key on default-value comparison rather than explicit-set detection; the STT connect payload drops input_audio_codec without explanation; and voice_id is never validated against the per-model speaker tuples the PR just built. Land after resolving the spec/code drift and picking a single enforcement discipline (raise vs. warn) consistent with the STT side.
